summary: SMX (Security Matters) Public Ltd Co filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment to its 2022 Incentive Equity Plan to increase authorized ordinary shares from ~2,442,092 to 4,754,592, and the grant of 2,300,000 RSUs to executives, directors, and service providers. No stockholder approval was sought, relying on Nasdaq foreign private issuer exemption. RSUs vest starting January 31, 2027. This is a routine equity compensation plan amendment and grant, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, premium, or strategic action involved. What to watch: potential dilution from the increased share pool.
